proposed_widenings.name: reroll_saving_throw in ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: Indomitable's core mechanic is rerolling a failed saving throw with a bonus equal to fighter level. The v4 atom modify_roll_reroll exists (TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §9) but ClassFeatureEffect only exposes grant_extra_action and heal_hp. A new variant is needed to map modify_roll_reroll into class feature mechanics, requiring: a rollKind constraint (saving_throw), a class-level scaling bonus (LinearPerLevel<number>, axis=class, base=9, perLevel=1, startingAtLevel=9 — yielding the fighter level), and forced-keep semantics (must use new roll).
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level. You must use the new roll

proposed_widenings.name: reaction in ClassFeatureActivationCost (trigger: on_save_fail)
proposed_widenings.justification: Indomitable fires reactively at the moment the fighter fails a saving throw — not as a voluntary free or bonus-action activation. The current ClassFeatureActivationCost only models proactive activations (free, bonus_action). A reaction variant with a closed trigger condition (on_save_fail) is needed so the tracer can place the activation in the correct window. The v4 relation branches_on_save exists but has no class-feature-side surface analog.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it

notes: The harness previously classified this as atom_widening, but that is incorrect: modify_roll_reroll and branches_on_save both appear in TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md v4 (§9 Effect Atoms, §10 Relation Types). The blocker is surface exposure only. Resource and reset shape fit perfectly: threshold_tiers 1@L9 -> 2@L13 -> 3@L17, long_rest reset, use_count resource — all representable with current types.
